rule: No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in @REF-001/V02. Never show a bare human face.

Any Iranian (Persian) flag or banner must match @PRP-016/V01 exactly: same cloth, colours and emblem. Never invent another flag design. This rule does not mean a flag has to appear. Only show one where the shot asks for it.

Zahhak's snakes are glossy black in every look and every shot. They are never tan, brown, green or patterned. If a Zahhak reference shows lighter snakes (the current main look @CHR-001/V02 does), keep everything else from that reference but make the snakes black.
The outside of Zahhak's palace, the building the Iranian nobles and commanders travel toward, is @LOC-018/V01. Do not replace it with any other building.
Jamshid wears no crown during his escape. Use the crownless look @CHR-002/V02 there, not the crowned @CHR-002/V01.
